hypothesis: V18 transport acceptance remains the immutable primary owner. A separately financed rejection add-on may improve ordinary cadence and month breadth without diluting V18 if it is admitted only when the existing product-neutral trend state agrees with the rejection direction and V18 is physically flat; any later V18 entry always preempts it.

owners.primary: unchanged V18 basis_breadth ledger, entries, directions, exits, costs, and outcomes
owners.addon: V41 immediate absorption or two-bar initiative failure whose exact completed trigger has DirectionalImpulse trend_state equal to its direction
owners.admission: addon projected entry must occur outside every immutable V18 entry-to-exit interval
owners.preemption: the next V18 entry is recorded as an unconditional maximum ownership boundary for any later lifecycle; the add-on may never delay, replace, invert, or modify V18

frozen_order: replay the unchanged V18 sensor causally and join each V41 event at its exact completed trigger
exclude every event whose projected entry overlaps an immutable V18 position interval
count discovery and validation periods without reading any add-on return, MFE, MAE, exit, PnL, or validation outcome
advance only if both count periods independently pass every frozen floor
if_eligible: Preregister one combined lifecycle in which V18 remains primary, the add-on uses the unchanged V42 branch-state exit, and a new V18 entry flattens the add-on at that exact MCL open before V18 admission. Discovery must improve the unchanged V18 primary and stress portfolio without weakening V18 or hiding add-on economics before validation opens.
prohibitions: no V18 filter, gate, direction, hold, exit, cost, or ledger mutation
no standalone trend-aligned V42 owner below the annual cadence floor
no alternate trend, slope, velocity, ATR, branch, anchor, side, month, or news profile
no add-on forward outcomes before count eligibility
no order, capital, XSP, or Gold authority
